question: Does adding causal, smooth local surface geometry and sphere-point tangential velocity features reduce paired-mean drift without regressing position or action response?
evidence: At 1800 updates the expanded model shows early tangential velocity error and excessive geometric slip proxy within the surface band. The mesh audit describes correlation and supplies no physical contact labels.

candidate.initialization: Use the identical fresh base network arrays and insert zero rows for added inputs into W1. Keep W3 zero at initialization.
unchanged: Residual state update and coarse integration
anchor and pair batches and group weights
SI scales, response masks and loss weights
Adam settings and S2 minibatch RNG
candidate.feature_source: At each lead use current predicted p,v,w and tool angular velocity at the start of this step. Recover Omega_tool from causal midpoint tilt/rate and held request via the existing half-step inverse filter. Initial ball state and actions are the only trajectory inputs.
candidate.slip_proxy: Tangential projection of v - R*cross(w - Omega_tool, n). This is the velocity of an ideal sphere point relative to the target tool.

surface_field.faces: Use local-tool triangles with upward facing normal (dot with nominal world-up in tool frame >= .2) and centroid tool x >= .22 m.
surface_field.grid_values: At each grid node, use closest selected face n and dot(point - closest_point, n) minus sphere radius. Smooth the three normal components and gap separately with Gaussian sigma one grid cell using nearest boundary extension.
surface_field.interpolation: Tensor cubic B-spline for each smoothed channel, with nearest extension and analytic spatial derivatives. Normalize the interpolated normal by sqrt(dot(n_raw,n_raw)+1e-12). Clamp sampling coordinates outside the grid; feature weight and its derivative must reach zero one cell before grid boundary.
surface_field.weight_g: Multiply smoothstep windows for all six domain edges and a gap window. Domain weights are zero in outer 1 cell and reach 1 inward at 3 cells. Gap weight is 1 at |gap| <= .003 m, falls to 0 at |gap| >= .008 m. Use smoothstep(u)=u^2*(3-2*u) on u clipped to [0,1].
surface_field.edge_behavior: Outside the local field and outside the near-surface band, new features and their derivatives are zero. Position, motion and departure are still predicted by the baseline residual path.

preflight: Freeze implementation, dependencies, grid/source hashes, and allocation size before fitting.
Record training coverage of the field and compare normal and gap to nearest-face geometry on the existing training snapshots. A flat-zero field or nonfinite field halts the run.
Verify the raw baseline and zero-feature extension agree at initialization.
Check state, known and parameter VJPs by centered finite differences, including taper regions and zero-feature cases. Check end-to-end requested-action VJP on causal multistep rollouts.
Check active-domain geometry near boundaries and show zero influence outside. Geometry never uses reference states or future measured tool poses for predictions.

evaluation.datasets: Same 36 development pairs (5 initial-state groups), grouped by cohort, physical initial state, history, and amplitude. Same S2 validation and complete routes. Original test trajectories stay sealed.
report: Free position and velocity in SI at H8/16/32
H32 pair-mean position and cumulative tangent velocity error
Strong directional counts and amplitude ratios
Face/gap and geometric slip proxy as descriptive diagnostics only
evaluation.required_protections: Keep all 22 existing criteria against the frozen original 900 baseline, and apply the same criteria against the matched expanded 1800 baseline. Preserve initial group and amplitude keys. H32 position <=1.1x baseline and both strong cosine counts nondecreasing; S2 complete-route H8 position <=1.1x baseline.
evaluation.interpretation: Use the single matched candidate and fixed endpoint, with no checkpoint selection. Development-informed representation proposal requires separate action-gradient realization and Newton control verification.

stop_conditions: split identity or source hash mismatch
